text_002.en: We develop thermal metrology and heat-transport engineering for next-generation integrated circuits, spanning high-thermal-conductivity materials, heterogeneous interfaces and bonding, and three-dimensional thermal tomography of interconnects. Our work primarily targets stacked computing chips and power/RF chips, covering materials, interfaces, micro- and nanoscale devices, wafer bonding and heterogeneous integration, chip packaging for space-based computing, microchannels, and thermal-testing equipment and techniques.
text_002.zh: 我们面向下一代集成电路发展热测试方法与热输运调控技术，研究涵盖高导热散热材料、异质界面与键合，以及互连结构的三维热层析。我们的工作主要面向算力堆叠芯片及功率／射频芯片，覆盖材料、界面、微纳米器件、晶圆键合与异质集成、面向太空算力的芯片封装、微流道，以及热测试设备与技术。

text_004.en: As chip power density, integration density, and reliability requirements keep rising, heat transport across materials, interfaces, interconnects, and package structures becomes a central constraint for performance and lifetime.
text_004.zh: 随着芯片功率密度、集成密度和可靠性要求不断提升，材料、界面、互连与封装结构中的热输运正成为制约器件性能与寿命的核心因素。

text_005.en: Our research connects experimental thermal metrology — TDTR, FDTR, and Raman mapping — with materials growth, interface engineering, and physical modeling, targeting the structures that matter in real devices: diamond and SiC heat spreaders, bonded interfaces, and 3D-stacked interconnect layers.
text_005.zh: 我们的研究将 TDTR、FDTR 与 Raman mapping 等实验热测试手段与材料生长、界面工程和物理建模相结合，聚焦真实器件中的关键结构：金刚石与碳化硅热扩散材料、键合界面以及三维堆叠互连层。
